title: Sparkly motorbike
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <filter id="glow">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="1.5" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
        <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g filter="url(#glow)">
    <polygon points="18,18 20,24 26,25 21,29 23,35 18,31 13,35 15,29 10,25 16,24" fill="#FFFF44"/>
    <polygon points="80,12 82,18 88,19 83,23 85,29 80,25 75,29 77,23 72,19 78,18" fill="#FFD700"/>
    <polygon points="88,45 89,49 93,50 89,51 88,55 87,51 83,50 87,49" fill="#FFAA00"/>
    <polygon points="12,55 13,59 17,60 13,61 12,65 11,61 7,60 11,59" fill="#FFFF88"/>
    <polygon points="25,75 26,79 30,80 26,81 25,85 24,81 20,80 24,79" fill="#FFD700"/>
    <polygon points="72,72 73,76 77,77 73,78 72,82 71,78 67,77 71,76" fill="#FFAA00"/>
    <polygon points="50,8 51,12 55,13 51,14 50,18 49,14 45,13 49,12" fill="#FFFF44"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Motorbike body - red -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="28" ry="12" fill="#EE3333"/>
  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="25" ry="7" fill="#FF5555"/>

  <!-- Seat - dark purple -->
  <rect x="35" y="46" width="22" height="8" rx="4" fill="#663399"/>

  <!-- Fuel tank - bright orange -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="50" rx="12" ry="7" fill="#FF8800"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="48" rx="9" ry="4" fill="#FFAA33"/>

  <!-- Handlebars -->
  <line x1="62" y1="48" x2="72" y2="40" stroke="#8888CC" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="48" x2="58" y2="40" stroke="#8888CC" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="40" r="3" fill="#AAAADD"/>

  <!-- Front fork -->
  <line x1="66" y1="55" x2="72" y2="40" stroke="#9999DD" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx="70" cy="50" r="5" fill="#FFFF88"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="50" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Rear wheel -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="72" r="12" fill="#333355"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="72" r="9" fill="#5555AA"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="72" r="4" fill="#8888DD"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="72" r="2" fill="#AAAACC"/>
  <!-- Spokes rear -->
  <line x1="32" y1="60" x2="32" y2="84" stroke="#7777BB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="72" x2="44" y2="72" stroke="#7777BB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="24" y1="64" x2="40" y2="80" stroke="#7777BB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="64" x2="24" y2="80" stroke="#7777BB" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Front wheel -->
  <circle cx="68" cy="72" r="12" fill="#333355"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="72" r="9" fill="#5555AA"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="72" r="4" fill="#8888DD"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="72" r="2" fill="#AAAACC"/>
  <!-- Spokes front -->
  <line x1="68" y1="60" x2="68" y2="84" stroke="#7777BB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="72" x2="80" y2="72" stroke="#7777BB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="64" x2="76" y2="80" stroke="#7777BB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="76" y1="64" x2="60" y2="80" stroke="#7777BB" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x="18" y="64" width="14" height="4" rx="2" fill="#CCCCDD"/>

  <!-- Frame connection -->
  <line x1="40" y1="62" x2="58" y2="62" stroke="#DD4444" stroke-width="3"/>
</svg>
